candidate.necessity_reason: Building this target requires compiling its entry against ares.h. The header moved to include/, while the old compile command supplies only -I.; the supplied root inventory has no root ares.h.

before.requirement: Compile the entry with the root-level ares.h.
before.reason: The old header was listed at the root, which -I. searches.

after.reason: The header is now under include/, but the entry compile command has no include/ search path.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The updated project test recipe shows the new header search path.

candidate.comparison_reason: The same -I. command finds the old root header but has no route to the moved header.

candidate.necessity_reason: The target links the project archive. The library build and project test link path moved under src/lib/, while the old harness still names the root archive.

before.requirement: Link the archive produced by the root libcares.la target.
before.reason: The library target was in the root build directory.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The old project test link recipe also references the root library target.

after.requirement: Link the archive produced by the src/lib library target.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The updated project test link recipe confirms the src/lib library location.

candidate.comparison_reason: The old archive path matches the root library layout but not the src/lib layout.

candidate.necessity_reason: PTR parsing accepts an address, length, and family and copies them into a successful host result. A valid PTR packet with an IPv6 address is feasible, but the complete entry always supplies one fixed IPv4 address and AF_INET.

before.requirement: Reach PTR parsing with an IPv6 address, its length, and AF_INET6.
before.reason: Fuzzer bytes control the packet only; the supplied address and family remain fixed at IPv4.

after.requirement: Reach PTR parsing with an IPv6 address, its length, and AF_INET6.
after.reason: The unchanged parser still supports those arguments; the same fixed IPv4 call cannot supply them.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete entry has no alternate PTR call with a different family.

candidate.comparison_reason: The concrete blocker on both sides is the same hard-coded IPv4 address and AF_INET argument. The parser's source list is relocated by g0118.

candidate.necessity_reason: The A parser can collect more than five valid A answers and writes TTL entries up to caller capacity. The entry fixes that capacity at five, so a six-answer packet cannot exercise writing the sixth TTL entry.

before.requirement: Reach A parsing with capacity for more than five returned address TTL entries.
before.reason: The entry always supplies a five-element array and count 5.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated packet parser iterates the answer count and appends matching A records.

after.requirement: Reach A parsing with capacity for more than five returned address TTL entries.
after.reason: The unchanged capacity check still permits a larger caller array; the old entry still supplies five slots.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated packet parser still appends matching A records across the answer loop.

candidate.comparison_reason: The same five-slot caller capacity prevents reaching a sixth TTL write on both sides. g0118 relocates this parser's source list.
